```{ojs}
sec31NdviSeasonal = {
  const mapMAM = new Map();
  const mapOND = new Map();
  for (const d of ndviCty) {
    if (d.ndvi_pct_normal == null) continue;
    const y = Number(d.year || (d.date ? d.date.slice(0, 4) : 0));
    const m = Number(d.date ? d.date.slice(5, 7) : 0);
    if (m >= 3 && m <= 5) {
      if (!mapMAM.has(y)) mapMAM.set(y, []);
      mapMAM.get(y).push(d.ndvi_pct_normal);
    } else if (m >= 10 && m <= 12) {
      if (!mapOND.has(y)) mapOND.set(y, []);
      mapOND.get(y).push(d.ndvi_pct_normal);
    }
  }
  const res = new Map();
  for (const y of sec31SurveyedYears) {
    const mamVals = mapMAM.get(y) || [];
    const ondVals = mapOND.get(y) || [];
    res.set(y, {
      mam: mamVals.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(mamVals)) : null,
      ond: ondVals.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(ondVals)) : null
    });
  }
  return res;
}
```

```{ojs}
sec31Medians = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const itm of (sec31Items || [])) {
    const vals = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm && d.val > 0).map((d) => d.val);
    m.set(itm, vals.length ? d3.median(vals) : 1);
  }
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
sec31Bimodal = sec31SurveyedYears.map((y) => {
  // Concurrent MAM (Long Rains of year y)
  const rM = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "MAM")?.value_mean;

  const anomM = rM != null && sec31ClimMAM > 0 ? ((rM - sec31ClimMAM) / sec31ClimMAM) * 100 : null;
  const speiM = sec31Spei.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "MAM")?.value_mean;

  // Concurrent OND (Short Rains of year y)
  const rO = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "OND")?.value_mean;
  const anomO = rO != null && sec31ClimOND > 0 ? ((rO - sec31ClimOND) / sec31ClimOND) * 100 : null;
  const speiO = sec31Spei.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "OND")?.value_mean;

  // Preceding OND (Short Rains of year y-1: contributes to year y harvest under national convention)
  const yPrec = y - 1;
  const rO_prec = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === yPrec && d.period === "OND")?.value_mean;
  const anomO_prec = rO_prec != null && sec31ClimOND > 0 ? ((rO_prec - sec31ClimOND) / sec31ClimOND) * 100 : null;
  const speiO_prec = sec31Spei.find((d) => d.year === yPrec && d.period === "OND")?.value_mean;

  // Preceding MAM (Long Rains of year y-1: for livestock cumulative forage lag)
  const rM_prec = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === yPrec && d.period === "MAM")?.value_mean;
  const anomM_prec = rM_prec != null && sec31ClimMAM > 0 ? ((rM_prec - sec31ClimMAM) / sec31ClimMAM) * 100 : null;

  // Drivers for year y
  const ninoMAM = rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "MAM", y);
  const ninoOND = (y >= 2023) ? (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", y)) : rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", y);
  const dmiMAM = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "MAM", y);
  const dmiOND = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y);
  const wnpMAM = rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", "MAM", y);

  // Preceding Drivers (y-1)
  const ninoOND_prec = (yPrec >= 2023) ? (roniRawOnd.get(yPrec) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", yPrec)) : rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", yPrec);
  const dmiOND_prec = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", yPrec);

  // Overlay driver evaluation
  let driverMAM = ninoMAM, driverOND = ninoOND, driverOND_prec = ninoOND_prec;
  if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("IOD")) {
    driverMAM = dmiMAM;
    driverOND = dmiOND;
    driverOND_prec = dmiOND_prec;
  } else if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("Western-V")) {
    driverMAM = wnpMAM;
    driverOND = null;
    driverOND_prec = null;
  }

  // Items data for this year
  const itemRecords = (sec31Items || []).map((itm) => {
    const row = sec31ProdRows.find((d) => d.item === itm && d.year === y);
    const med = sec31Medians.get(itm) || 1;
    const val = row ? row.val : null;
    const dev = (med > 0 && val != null) ? ((val - med) / med) * 100 : null;
    return {
      item: itm,
      val,
      dev,
      unit: row ? row.unit : (sec31Group === "Crops" ? "t" : sec31Group === "Livestock" ? "head" : "KSh")
    };
  });

  const primaryRec = itemRecords.find((r) => r.item === sec31PrimaryItem) || itemRecords[0] || { val: null, unit: "" };

  return {
    year: y,
    // Concurrent year y
    rainMAM: rM, anomMAM: anomM, speiMAM: speiM,
    rainOND: rO, anomOND: anomO, speiOND: speiO,
    // Preceding year y-1 (harvest-aligned for crops)
    rainOND_prec: rO_prec, anomOND_prec: anomO_prec, speiOND_prec: speiO_prec,
    rainMAM_prec: rM_prec, anomMAM_prec: anomM_prec,
    // MODIS NDVI
    ndviMAM: sec31NdviSeasonal.get(y)?.mam,
    ndviOND: sec31NdviSeasonal.get(y)?.ond,
    ndviOND_prec: sec31NdviSeasonal.get(yPrec)?.ond,
    // Ocean Drivers
    wnp: wnpMAM,
    roni: ninoOND,
    roni_prec: ninoOND_prec,
    nino34: ninoOND,
    nino34_prec: ninoOND_prec,
    dmi: dmiOND,
    dmi_prec: dmiOND_prec,
    driverMAM,
    driverOND,
    driverOND_prec,
    // Lagged markers for livestock
    anomMAM_lag: anomM_prec,
    anomOND_lag: anomO_prec,
    ninoLag: ninoOND_prec,
    itemRecords,
    prodVal: primaryRec.val,
    unit: primaryRec.unit
  };
})
```

```{ojs}
// Figure 4.1: Aligned Production Timeline & Environmental Overlays
sec31Chart = {
  const meta = sec31DriverMeta;
  const surveyedYrs = sec31SurveyedYears;
  const minYr = d3.min(surveyedYrs);
  const maxYr = d3.max(surveyedYrs);
  const xDomain = [minYr - 0.5, maxYr + 0.5];
  const isCrops = sec31Group === "Crops";

  if (!sec31ProdRows.length) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 2.5rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;">
      No surveyed production records for selected items in ${county} (KNBS audited).
    </div>`;
  }

  const isNormalized = sec31ScaleMode.startsWith("Normalized");
  const items = sec31Items || [];

  const isHighlightActive = Boolean(similarHighlightActive);

  // Helper to test whether an overlay bar represents a similar season
  function isSimilarBar(d) {
    if (!isHighlightActive) return false;
    const isPreceding = d.season && d.season.includes("Preceding");
    const calYr = isPreceding ? d.year - 1 : d.year;
    const isOND = d.season && d.season.includes("OND");
    const isMAM = d.season && d.season.includes("MAM");

    if (sec31Overlay === "Ocean Driver Anomaly") {
      if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("ENSO")) {
        return Boolean(isOND && ensoPhaseOND.get(calYr) === "El Niño");
      } else if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("IOD")) {
        return Boolean(isOND && iodPhaseOND.get(calYr) === "IOD positive");
      } else {
        return Boolean(isMAM && wnpPhaseMAM.get(calYr) === "Western-V high");
      }
    }
    if (activeSeason === "OND") {
      return Boolean(isOND && ensoPhaseOND.get(calYr) === "El Niño");
    } else {
      return Boolean(isMAM && wnpPhaseMAM.get(calYr) === "Western-V high");
    }
  }

  // Set of harvest/survey years where at least one contributing season is similar
  const prodHighlightedYears = new Set(
    sec31Bimodal.filter((d) => {
      if (!isHighlightActive) return false;
      const yrOND = isCrops ? d.year - 1 : d.year;
      const yrMAM = d.year;
      if (sec31Overlay === "Ocean Driver Anomaly") {
        if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("ENSO")) return ensoPhaseOND.get(yrOND) === "El Niño";
        if (sec31DriverOverlay.startsWith("IOD")) return iodPhaseOND.get(yrOND) === "IOD positive";
        return wnpPhaseMAM.get(yrMAM) === "Western-V high";
      }
      if (activeSeason === "OND") return ensoPhaseOND.get(yrOND) === "El Niño";
      return wnpPhaseMAM.get(yrMAM) === "Western-V high";
    }).map((d) => d.year)
  );

  // Flatten series for multi-crop plotting
  const plotSeries = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const itm = items[i];
    const color = COMMODITY_COLORS[i % COMMODITY_COLORS.length];
    const med = sec31Medians.get(itm) || 1;
    const rows = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm);
    for (const r of rows) {
      const normVal = med > 0 ? (r.val / med) * 100 : 100;
      plotSeries.push({
        item: itm,
        year: r.year,
        val: r.val,
        normVal,
        yVal: isNormalized ? normVal : r.val,
        color,
        unit: r.unit,
        med
      });
    }
  }

  const yMax = isNormalized
    ? Math.max(160, (d3.max(plotSeries, (d) => d.normVal) || 100) * 1.15)
    : (d3.max(plotSeries, (d) => d.yVal) || 100) * 1.15;

  const unitStr = sec31Bimodal[0]?.unit || (isCrops ? "t" : "head");
  const yLabel = isNormalized
    ? "Output Index (% of Median)"
    : (items.length === 1 ? `${items[0]} (${unitStr})` : `${sec31Group} Output (${unitStr})`);

  // 1. Primary Multi-Commodity Production Plot (Panel A: x-axis suppressed for seamless dual-panel alignment)
  const pProd = Plot.plot({
    width: 880,
    height: 220,
    marginLeft: 70,
    marginRight: 95,
    marginBottom: 4,
    x: { domain: xDomain, ticks: surveyedYrs, axis: null },
    y: {
      label: yLabel,
      grid: true,
      domain: [0, yMax],
      tickFormat: isNormalized ? (v) => `${v}%` : (v) => v >= 1e6 ? (v / 1e6).toFixed(1) + "M" : v >= 1e3 ? (v / 1e3).toFixed(1) + "K" : String(v)
    },
    marks: [
      isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0
        ? Plot.rectX([...prodHighlightedYears], {
            x1: (yr) => yr - 0.42,
            x2: (yr) => yr + 0.42,
            fill: "#38bdf8",
            fillOpacity: 0.12
          })
        : null,
      isNormalized ? Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.2}) : null,
      isNormalized ? Plot.text([100], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => "Median Base Rate (100%)", fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4}) : null,
      ...items.map((itm, i) => {
        const itmRows = plotSeries.filter((d) => d.item === itm);
        const col = COMMODITY_COLORS[i % COMMODITY_COLORS.length];
        return Plot.lineY(itmRows, {
          x: "year", y: "yVal", stroke: col, strokeWidth: 2.4,
          strokeOpacity: isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0 ? 0.45 : 1.0
        });
      }),
      ...items.map((itm, i) => {
        const itmRows = plotSeries.filter((d) => d.item === itm);
        const col = COMMODITY_COLORS[i % COMMODITY_COLORS.length];
        return Plot.dot(itmRows, {
          x: "year", y: "yVal",
          fill: col,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0 ? (prodHighlightedYears.has(d.year) ? 1.0 : 0.22) : 1.0,
          stroke: (d) => isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.has(d.year) ? "#0f172a" : "#ffffff",
          strokeWidth: (d) => isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.has(d.year) ? 2.5 : 1.5,
          r: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (prodHighlightedYears.has(d.year) ? 7.0 : 4.5) : 5.5,
          channels: {
            Commodity: "item",
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Production: (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.val)} ${d.unit}`,
            "Index vs Median": (d) => `${Math.round(d.normVal)}% of median (${d.normVal >= 100 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(d.normVal - 100)}%)`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Commodity: true, Year: true, Production: true, "Index vs Median": true}}
        });
      }),
      ...items.map((itm, i) => {
        const itmRows = plotSeries.filter((d) => d.item === itm);
        const col = COMMODITY_COLORS[i % COMMODITY_COLORS.length];
        return Plot.text(itmRows, {
          x: "year", y: "yVal",
          text: (d) => isNormalized ? `${Math.round(d.normVal)}%` : formatNumCompactShort()(d.val),
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0 ? (prodHighlightedYears.has(d.year) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: -12, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 700, fill: col
        });
      })
    ]
  });

  // 2. Harmonized Bimodal Environmental Driver Overlays (Panel B)
  let overlayPlot = null;
  let overlayLabel = "";

  // Seasonal definitions depending on commodity type
  const season1Label = isCrops ? "Preceding OND (Short Rains t-1)" : "MAM (Long Rains)";
  const season2Label = isCrops ? "Concurrent MAM (Long Rains t)" : "OND (Short Rains)";
  const seasonColors = isCrops ? ["#6366f1", "#0284c7"] : ["#0284c7", "#6366f1"];

  if (sec31Overlay === "Rainfall Anomaly (%)") {
    overlayLabel = "Seasonal Rainfall Signal (% vs. 1991–2020 Normal)";
    const rainBars = [];
    for (const d of sec31Bimodal) {
      const v1 = isCrops ? d.anomOND_prec : d.anomMAM;
      const v2 = isCrops ? d.anomMAM : d.anomOND;
      if (v1 != null) rainBars.push({year: d.year, season: season1Label, val: v1, offset: -0.16});
      if (v2 != null) rainBars.push({year: d.year, season: season2Label, val: v2, offset: 0.16});
    }
    overlayPlot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 165,
      marginLeft: 70,
      marginRight: 95,
      marginTop: 6,
      marginBottom: 28,
      x: { domain: xDomain, ticks: surveyedYrs, tickFormat: "d", label: isCrops ? "Harvest Year" : "Survey Year" },
      y: {
        label: "Rainfall Anomaly (%) [↑ Wetter | ↓ Drier]",
        grid: true,
        tickFormat: (v) => `${v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${v}%`
      },
      color: {
        domain: [season1Label, season2Label],
        range: seasonColors,
        legend: true
      },
      marks: [
        isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0
          ? Plot.rectX([...prodHighlightedYears], {
              x1: (yr) => yr - 0.42,
              x2: (yr) => yr + 0.42,
              fill: "#38bdf8",
              fillOpacity: 0.12
            })
          : null,
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.rectY(rainBars, {
          x1: (d) => d.year + d.offset - 0.14,
          x2: (d) => d.year + d.offset + 0.14,
          y: "val",
          fill: "season",
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.22) : 1.0,
          stroke: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? "#0f172a" : "none",
          strokeWidth: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? 1.4 : 0,
          inset: 0.5,
          channels: {
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),

            Anomaly: (d) => `${d.val > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.val)}% vs 1991–2020 normal`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Season: true, Anomaly: true}}
        }),
        Plot.text(rainBars.filter((d) => d.val >= 0), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `+${Math.round(d.val)}%`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: -8, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        }),
        Plot.text(rainBars.filter((d) => d.val < 0), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `${Math.round(d.val)}%`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: 10, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        })
      ]
    });
  } else if (sec31Overlay === "Ocean Driver Anomaly") {
    overlayLabel = `${meta.name} (${meta.unit})`;
    const driverBars = [];
    for (const d of sec31Bimodal) {
      const v1 = isCrops ? d.driverOND_prec : d.driverMAM;

      if (v1 != null) driverBars.push({year: d.year, season: season1Label, val: v1, offset: -0.16});
      if (v2 != null) driverBars.push({year: d.year, season: season2Label, val: v2, offset: 0.16});
    }
    const driverLabelDirection = meta.short.startsWith("Western-V")
      ? `${meta.name} (${meta.unit}) [↑ Higher Rainfall | ↓ Suppression]`
      : `${meta.name} (${meta.unit}) [↑ Wetter (+Teleconnection) | ↓ Drier]`;

    overlayPlot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,

      marginLeft: 70,

      y: { label: driverLabelDirection, grid: true, nice: true },
      color: {
        domain: [season1Label, season2Label],
        range: seasonColors,
        legend: true
      },
      marks: [
        isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0
          ? Plot.rectX([...prodHighlightedYears], {
              x1: (yr) => yr - 0.42,
              x2: (yr) => yr + 0.42,
              fill: "#38bdf8",

          : null,

        Plot.rectY(driverBars, {

          strokeWidth: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? 1.4 : 0,

          channels: {
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Season: "season",

            Value: (d) => `${d.val > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.val.toFixed(2)} ${meta.unit}`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Season: true, Driver: true, Value: true}}
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([meta.posThresh, meta.negThresh], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.text([meta.posThresh], {
          x: () => maxYr + 0.5, y: () => meta.posThresh,
          textAnchor: "start", dx: 8,
          text: () => `+${meta.posThresh} ${meta.unit} (${meta.posLabel})`,
          fill: "#0369a1", fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600
        }),
        Plot.text([meta.negThresh], {
          x: () => maxYr + 0.5, y: () => meta.negThresh,
          textAnchor: "start", dx: 8,
          text: () => `${meta.negThresh} ${meta.unit} (${meta.negLabel})`,

        }),
        Plot.text(driverBars.filter((d) => d.val >= 0), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `+${d.val.toFixed(1)}`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: -8, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        }),

          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `${d.val.toFixed(1)}`,

          dy: 10, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        })
      ]
    });
  } else if (sec31Overlay === "Drought Index (SPEI-3)") {
    overlayLabel = "Meteorological Drought Index (Vicente-Serrano SPEI-3)";
    const speiBars = [];
    for (const d of sec31Bimodal) {
      const v1 = isCrops ? d.speiOND_prec : d.speiMAM;
      const v2 = isCrops ? d.speiMAM : d.speiOND;
      if (v1 != null) speiBars.push({year: d.year, season: season1Label, val: v1, offset: -0.16});
      if (v2 != null) speiBars.push({year: d.year, season: season2Label, val: v2, offset: 0.16});
    }
    overlayPlot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,

      x: { domain: xDomain, ticks: surveyedYrs, tickFormat: "d", label: isCrops ? "Harvest Year" : "Survey Year" },
      y: { label: "SPEI-3 Drought Index [↑ Wetter / Surplus | ↓ Severe Drought]", grid: true },
      color: {
        domain: [season1Label, season2Label],
        range: seasonColors,
        legend: true
      },
      marks: [
        isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0
          ? Plot.rectX([...prodHighlightedYears], {
              x1: (yr) => yr - 0.42,
              x2: (yr) => yr + 0.42,
              fill: "#38bdf8",
              fillOpacity: 0.12
            })
          : null,
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.rectY(speiBars, {
          x1: (d) => d.year + d.offset - 0.14,
          x2: (d) => d.year + d.offset + 0.14,
          y: "val",
          fill: "season",
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.22) : 1.0,
          stroke: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? "#0f172a" : "none",
          strokeWidth: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? 1.4 : 0,
          inset: 0.5,
          channels: {
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Season: "season",
            SPEI: (d) => d.val.toFixed(2)
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Season: true, SPEI: true}}
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([-1.0], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.text([-1.0], {
          x: () => maxYr + 0.5, y: () => -1.0,
          textAnchor: "start", dx: 8,
          text: () => "Drought Threshold (-1.0)",
          fill: "#dc2626", fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600
        }),
        Plot.text(speiBars.filter((d) => d.val >= 0), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `+${d.val.toFixed(1)}`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: -8, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        }),
        Plot.text(speiBars.filter((d) => d.val < 0), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => d.val.toFixed(1),
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: 10, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#334155"
        })
      ]
    });
  } else if (sec31Overlay === "Pasture NDVI (%)") {
    overlayLabel = "Pasture Biomass Condition (MODIS 250m NDVI % of Normal)";
    const ndviBars = [];
    for (const d of sec31Bimodal) {
      const v1 = isCrops ? d.ndviOND_prec : d.ndviMAM;
      const v2 = isCrops ? d.ndviMAM : d.ndviOND;
      if (v1 != null) ndviBars.push({year: d.year, season: season1Label, val: v1, dev: v1 - 100, offset: -0.16});
      if (v2 != null) ndviBars.push({year: d.year, season: season2Label, val: v2, dev: v2 - 100, offset: 0.16});
    }
    overlayPlot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 165,
      marginLeft: 70,
      marginRight: 95,
      marginTop: 6,
      marginBottom: 28,
      x: { domain: xDomain, ticks: surveyedYrs, tickFormat: "d", label: isCrops ? "Harvest Year" : "Survey Year" },
      y: { label: "Pasture Condition (% of Normal) [↑ Lush Flush | ↓ Forage Deficit]", grid: true, domain: [50, 175], tickFormat: (v) => `${v}%` },
      color: {
        domain: [season1Label, season2Label],
        range: seasonColors,
        legend: true
      },
      marks: [
        isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0
          ? Plot.rectX([...prodHighlightedYears], {
              x1: (yr) => yr - 0.42,
              x2: (yr) => yr + 0.42,
              fill: "#38bdf8",
              fillOpacity: 0.12
            })
          : null,
        Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        Plot.rectY(ndviBars, {
          x1: (d) => d.year + d.offset - 0.14,
          x2: (d) => d.year + d.offset + 0.14,
          y1: 100,
          y2: "val",
          fill: "season",
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.22) : 1.0,
          stroke: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? "#0f172a" : "none",
          strokeWidth: (d) => (isHighlightActive && isSimilarBar(d)) ? 1.4 : 0,
          inset: 0.5,
          channels: {
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Season: "season",
            "Pasture Condition": (d) => `${d.val}% of normal (${d.dev >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.dev}%)`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Season: true, "Pasture Condition": true}}
        }),
        Plot.text([100], {
          x: () => maxYr + 0.5, y: () => 100,
          textAnchor: "start", dx: 8,
          text: () => "Normal Baseline (100%)",
          fill: "#475569", fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 600
        }),
        Plot.text(ndviBars.filter((d) => d.val >= 100), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `${d.val}%`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: -8, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 700, fill: "#334155"
        }),
        Plot.text(ndviBars.filter((d) => d.val < 100), {
          x: (d) => d.year + d.offset, y: "val",
          text: (d) => `${d.val}%`,
          fillOpacity: (d) => isHighlightActive ? (isSimilarBar(d) ? 1.0 : 0.18) : 1.0,
          dy: 10, fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 700, fill: "#334155"
        })
      ]
    });
  }

  const livestockLagBanner = !isCrops ? html`
    <div style="background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-left: 4px solid #d97706; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #92400e; margin-bottom: 0.65rem;">
      <strong>Pastoral Herd Lag Dynamics (6–12 Month Biological &amp; Demographic Delay):</strong> Livestock mortality, emergency destocking, and herd contraction lag meteorological drought by 6–12 months. Peak losses in 2022 and 2023 reflect cumulative multi-season forage depletion from 2020–2022. Calving rebound and herd reconstitution following rain flushes require 1–3 years of breeding cycles.
    </div>
  ` : "";

  const commodityLegend = html`
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">
      <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #334155;">Commodity:</span>
      ${items.map((itm, i) => html`
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b;">
          <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${COMMODITY_COLORS[i % COMMODITY_COLORS.length]}; display: inline-block;"></span>
          <span>${itm}</span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b;">(Med: ${formatNumCompactShort()(sec31Medians.get(itm) || 0)} ${sec31ProdRows.find(d => d.item === itm)?.unit || ''})</span>
        </span>
      `)}
      ${isNormalized ? html`<span style="margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; font-style: italic;">Normalized to 100% = County Median for cross-commodity comparison</span>` : ""}
    </div>
  `;

  const highlightBadge = (isHighlightActive && prodHighlightedYears.size > 0)
    ? html`<span style="background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px;">★ Highlighting ${prodHighlightedYears.size} similar season${prodHighlightedYears.size > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>`
    : "";

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem;">
      ${livestockLagBanner}
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.15rem;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
          Figure 4.1: County Production vs. Climate Driver Overlays (${minYr}–${maxYr})
        </div>
        ${highlightBadge}
      </div>
      ${commodityLegend}
      <div style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 0.25rem;">
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
          <span style="background: #e2e8f0; color: #1e293b; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800;">PANEL A</span>
          <span>KNBS Agricultural &amp; Livestock Output Series</span>
        </span>
        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: normal;">${isNormalized ? "Indexed vs. County Median (100%)" : `Metric: ${unitStr}`}</span>
      </div>
      ${pProd}
      <div style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 0.45rem;">
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
          <span style="background: #e2e8f0; color: #1e293b; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800;">PANEL B</span>
          <span>Integrated Overlay: ${overlayLabel} (${isCrops ? 'Preceding OND & Concurrent MAM' : 'MAM & OND'})</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      ${overlayPlot}
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Table 4.1: Dual-Season Balance Sheet (Surveyed Years Only)
sec31Table = {
  const isLivestock = sec31Group === "Livestock";

  const rows = sec31Bimodal.map((d) => {
    // Current climate strings
    const mamTxt = d.anomMAM != null
      ? `${d.anomMAM >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.anomMAM)}% (${d.wnp != null ? (d.wnp >= 0.5 ? "High W-V" : d.wnp <= -0.5 ? "Low W-V" : "Neutral") : "—"})`
      : "—";

    const ondTxt = d.anomOND != null
      ? `${d.anomOND >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.anomOND)}% (${d.nino34 != null ? (d.nino34 >= 0.5 ? "El Niño" : d.nino34 <= -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral") : "—"})`
      : "—";

    // Preceding OND (Short Rains t-1 for crops)
    const ondPrecTxt = d.anomOND_prec != null
      ? `${d.anomOND_prec >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.anomOND_prec)}% (${d.nino34_prec != null ? (d.nino34_prec >= 0.5 ? "El Niño" : d.nino34_prec <= -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral") : "—"})`
      : "—";

    // Lagged climate string (t-1) for livestock
    const lagTxt = d.anomMAM_lag != null && d.anomOND_lag != null
      ? `MAM: ${d.anomMAM_lag >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.anomMAM_lag)}% · OND: ${d.anomOND_lag >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.anomOND_lag)}% (${d.ninoLag >= 0.5 ? 'El Niño' : d.ninoLag <= -0.5 ? 'La Niña' : 'Neutral'})`
      : "Baseline";

    // Multi-item output pills
    const cropOutputs = d.itemRecords.filter(r => r.val != null).map((r) => html`
      <div style="margin: 2px 0;">
        <strong style="color: #1e293b;">${r.item}:</strong>
        <span style="color: #334155; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;"> ${formatNumCompactShort()(r.val)} ${r.unit}</span>
      </div>
    `);

    const devPills = d.itemRecords.filter(r => r.val != null).map((r) => {
      const med = sec31Medians.get(r.item) || 1;
      const dev = med > 0 ? ((r.val - med) / med) * 100 : 0;
      const devCol = dev >= 15 ? "#15803d" : dev <= -20 ? "#b91c1c" : "#334155";
      const devBg = dev >= 15 ? "#dcfce7" : dev <= -20 ? "#fee2e2" : "#f1f5f9";
      const showLabel = d.itemRecords.length > 1;
      return html`
        <div style="margin: 2px 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px;">
          ${showLabel ? html`<span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">${r.item}:</span>` : ""}
          <span style="color: ${devCol}; background: ${devBg}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; min-width: 52px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${dev >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dev.toFixed(0)}%
          </span>
        </div>
      `;
    });

    const livestockOutputsHtml = d.itemRecords.filter(r => r.val != null).map((r) => {
      const med = sec31Medians.get(r.item) || 1;
      const dev = med > 0 ? ((r.val - med) / med) * 100 : 0;
      const devCol = dev >= 15 ? "#15803d" : dev <= -20 ? "#b91c1c" : "#334155";
      return html`
        <div style="margin: 2px 0;">
          <strong style="color: #1e293b;">${r.item}:</strong> <span style="font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">${formatNumCompactShort()(r.val)} ${r.unit}</span>
          <span style="color: ${devCol}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.74rem;"> (${dev >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dev.toFixed(0)}%)</span>
        </div>
      `;
    });

    if (isLivestock) {
      let lagDiagnosis = "Pastoral forage baseline; normal calving and lactation rates.";
      if (d.year === 2021) {
        lagDiagnosis = "La Niña onset: dry-season forage reserves depleted; breeding intervals extend.";
      } else if (d.year === 2022) {
        lagDiagnosis = "Peak mortality & distress destocking triggered by cumulative 2020–2021 failed seasons.";
      } else if (d.year === 2023) {
        lagDiagnosis = "Bottoming out of breeding stock after 5 failed seasons; late-2023 El Niño rains trigger slow recovery.";
      } else if (d.year === 2024) {
        lagDiagnosis = "Post-deluge forage recovery; herd rebuilding underway across ASAL rangelands.";
      }

      return html`
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; vertical-align: top;">${d.year}</td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #475569; font-size: 0.78rem; vertical-align: top;">${lagTxt}</td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: ${d.anomOND >= 0 ? "#0369a1" : "#b91c1c"}; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; vertical-align: top;">
            MAM: ${mamTxt}<br/>OND: ${ondTxt}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #0f172a; vertical-align: top;">${livestockOutputsHtml}</td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.76rem; color: #78350f; line-height: 1.4; vertical-align: top; max-width: 260px;">
            ${lagDiagnosis}
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }

    // Crops balance sheet row: Preceding OND(t-1) + Concurrent MAM(t)
    return html`
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
        <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; vertical-align: top;">${d.year}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: ${d.anomOND_prec >= 0 ? "#4338ca" : "#b91c1c"}; font-weight: 600; vertical-align: top;">${ondPrecTxt}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: ${d.anomMAM >= 0 ? "#0369a1" : "#b91c1c"}; font-weight: 600; vertical-align: top;">${mamTxt}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #0f172a; vertical-align: top;">${cropOutputs}</td>
        <td style="padding: 8px 10px; vertical-align: top;">${devPills}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });

  if (isLivestock) {
    return html`
      <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: inherit;">
        <thead>
          <tr style="background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 0.74rem;">
            <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Survey Year</th>
            <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Preceding Shock (t-1 MAM &bull; OND)</th>
            <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Concurrent Shock (t MAM &bull; OND)</th>
            <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Surveyed Herd Stock</th>
            <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">6–12 Month Lagged Causal Diagnosis</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${rows}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    `;
  }

  return html`
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: inherit;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 0.74rem;">
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Harvest Year</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Preceding Short Rains (OND Y-1 &bull; Teleconnection)</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Concurrent Long Rains (MAM Y &bull; Teleconnection)</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Crop Production</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">% vs. County Median</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Mount Figure 4.1 / Table 4.1 to sec31ContentHost and fig41FooterHost
{
  [county, sec31Items, sec31Group, sec31Chart, sec31Table, sec31ViewMode];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec31ContentHost");
  if (host) {
    const isPlot = sec31ViewMode.startsWith("Plot");
    host.replaceChildren(isPlot ? sec31Chart : sec31Table);
  }
  const oldPlotHost = document.getElementById("plotProductionHost");
  if (oldPlotHost && sec31Chart) oldPlotHost.replaceChildren(sec31Chart);
  const oldTableHost = document.getElementById("table31Host");
  if (oldTableHost && sec31Table) oldTableHost.replaceChildren(sec31Table);

  const footerHost = document.getElementById("fig41FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Dual-season oceanic teleconnections vs. KNBS agricultural output for ${sec31Items.join(', ')} in ${county} (${d3.min(sec31SurveyedYears)}–${d3.max(sec31SurveyedYears)} surveyed years).`,
      footerHost,
      {
        fig: "4.1",
        filename: `${county}_production_vs_climate`,
        data: sec31Bimodal,
        about: `Official annual agricultural and livestock statistics from the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS NAPR audited editions) reconciled with CHIRPS v3 bimodal rainfall anomalies (1991–2020 baseline) and oceanic teleconnection indices. Demonstrates how consecutive single-season vs dual-season shocks propagate through county food production and pastoral herds.`,
        meta: {County: county, Sector: sec31Group, Items: sec31Items.join(', '), Overlay: sec31Overlay}
      }
    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
sec31bMeta = {

    return {

      posCrit: "≥ +0.4 °C",

      isPos: (v) => v >= 0.4,
      isNeg: (v) => v <= -0.4,
      posColor: "#0284c7",
      neuColor: "#64748b",
      negColor: "#dc2626"
    };
  } else {
    return {
      name: "Western-V Gradient Index",

      key: "wnp",

      neuLabel: "Neutral",
      posCrit: "≥ +0.5 σ",

      neuCrit: "-0.5 to +0.5 σ",
      isPos: (v) => v >= 0.5,
      isNeg: (v) => v <= -0.5,
      posColor: "#0284c7",
      neuColor: "#64748b",
      negColor: "#dc2626"
    };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
// Figure 4.2: Empirical Phase Response Chart (Dot + Range Interval Plot)
sec31bChart = {
  const meta = sec31bMeta;
  const items = sec31Items || [];
  const isCrops = sec31Group === "Crops";

  if (!sec31ProdRows.length || !items.length) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 2rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;">
      No production records available for empirical phase response.
    </div>`;
  }

  // Visual Legend Key explaining what each dot and line represents
  const legendKey = html`
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">Chart Legend:</span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0f172a; border: 2.5px solid #2563eb; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <strong>Empirical Phase Mean</strong> (average across all surveyed years in this phase)
      </span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2563eb; border: 1.5px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #94a3b8; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <span>Individual Surveyed Year (single KNBS record)</span>
      </span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 20px; height: 4px; background: #2563eb; opacity: 0.65; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <span>Observed Min–Max Production Range</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  `;

  // Build empirical phase summaries for each selected commodity
  const itemCards = items.map((itm) => {
    const rows = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm && d.val > 0);
    const unitStr = rows[0]?.unit || (isCrops ? "t" : "head");

    const phaseRecords = rows.map((d) => {
      const bimo = sec31Bimodal.find((b) => b.year === d.year);
      const driverVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.key] : null;
      const rainVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.rainKey] : null;
      let phase = meta.neuLabel;
      if (driverVal != null) {
        if (meta.isPos(driverVal)) phase = meta.posLabel;
        else if (meta.isNeg(driverVal)) phase = meta.negLabel;
      }
      return { ...d, driverVal, rainVal, phase };
    });

    const phases = [
      { label: meta.posLabel, crit: meta.posCrit, color: meta.posColor },
      { label: meta.neuLabel, crit: meta.neuCrit, color: meta.neuColor },
      { label: meta.negLabel, crit: meta.negCrit, color: meta.negColor }
    ];

    const phaseStats = phases.map((p) => {
      const pRows = phaseRecords.filter((r) => r.phase === p.label);
      const count = pRows.length;
      const meanVal = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const medVal = count ? d3.median(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const minVal = count ? d3.min(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const maxVal = count ? d3.max(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const meanRain = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.rainVal) : null;
      const years = pRows.map((r) => r.year).sort().join(", ");
      return {
        phase: p.label,
        crit: p.crit,
        color: p.color,
        count,
        meanVal,
        medVal,
        minVal,
        maxVal,
        meanRain,
        years: years || "None observed"
      };
    });

    const maxObs = d3.max(phaseRecords, (d) => d.val) || 100;
    const xMax = maxObs * 1.35;

    // Dot + Interval Plot
    const pDotInterval = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 195,
      marginLeft: 155,
      marginRight: 95,
      marginBottom: 35,
      x: {
        label: `${itm} Output (${unitStr}) [Interval: Min–Max Range • Dot: Empirical Mean • Markers: Surveyed Years]`,
        domain: [0, xMax],
        grid: true,
        nice: true,
        tickFormat: (v) => formatNumCompactShort()(v)
      },
      y: { domain: [meta.posLabel, meta.neuLabel, meta.negLabel], label: null },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        // Observed Range Interval line
        Plot.link(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0 && d.minVal != null), {
          y: "phase",
          x1: "minVal",
          x2: "maxVal",
          stroke: "color",
          strokeWidth: 4,
          strokeOpacity: 0.65
        }),
        // Individual surveyed years
        Plot.dot(phaseRecords, {
          y: "phase",
          x: "val",
          fill: (d) => {
            const p = phases.find((x) => x.label === d.phase);
            return p ? p.color : "#64748b";
          },
          stroke: "#ffffff",
          strokeWidth: 1.5,
          r: 5,
          channels: {
            Symbol: () => "Single-Year Surveyed Output",
            Commodity: "item",
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Phase: "phase",
            "Recorded Output": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.val)} ${d.unit || unitStr}`
          },
          tip: {format: {fill: false, Symbol: true, Commodity: true, Year: true, Phase: true, "Recorded Output": true}}
        }),
        // Mean Dot
        Plot.dot(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0 && d.meanVal != null), {
          y: "phase",
          x: "meanVal",
          fill: "#0f172a",
          stroke: "color",
          strokeWidth: 2.5,
          r: 7.5,
          channels: {
            Symbol: () => "Empirical Phase Mean (Multi-Year Average)",
            Phase: "phase",
            Criterion: "crit",
            "Empirical Mean": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.meanVal)} ${unitStr}`,
            "Observed Range": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.minVal)} – ${formatNumCompactShort()(d.maxVal)} ${unitStr}`,
            "Sample Size": (d) => `${d.count} years (${d.years})`
          },
          tip: {format: {fill: false, Symbol: true, Phase: true, Criterion: true, "Empirical Mean": true, "Observed Range": true, "Sample Size": true}}
        }),
        // Annotation text
        Plot.text(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0), {
          y: "phase",
          x: (d) => d.maxVal || d.meanVal,
          text: (d) => `  Phase Mean: ${formatNumCompactShort()(d.meanVal)} ${unitStr} (n=${d.count}: ${d.years})`,
          dx: 8,
          textAnchor: "start",
          fontSize: 9.5,
          fontWeight: 700,
          fill: "#1e293b"
        })
      ]
    });

    return html`
      <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; padding-bottom: 0.5rem;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">
            ${itm} <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: #64748b;">(Unit: ${unitStr} &bull; KNBS Audited)</span>
          </h4>
          <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600;">
            Conditioned on ${meta.name} (${meta.season})
          </span>
        </div>
        ${pDotInterval}
      </div>
    `;
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;">
      ${legendKey}
      ${itemCards}
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Table 4.2: Empirical Ocean Driver Phase Summary Table
sec31bTable = {
  const meta = sec31bMeta;
  const items = sec31Items || [];
  const isCrops = sec31Group === "Crops";

  if (!sec31ProdRows.length || !items.length) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 1.5rem; color: #64748b;">No data available for Table 4.2.</div>`;
  }

  const tableRows = [];
  const phases = [
    { label: meta.posLabel, crit: meta.posCrit, color: meta.posColor, bg: "#f0f9ff" },
    { label: meta.neuLabel, crit: meta.neuCrit, color: meta.neuColor, bg: "#f8fafc" },
    { label: meta.negLabel, crit: meta.negCrit, color: meta.negColor, bg: "#fef2f2" }
  ];

  for (const itm of items) {
    const rows = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm && d.val > 0);
    const unitStr = rows[0]?.unit || (isCrops ? "t" : "head");

    const phaseRecords = rows.map((d) => {
      const bimo = sec31Bimodal.find((b) => b.year === d.year);
      const driverVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.key] : null;
      const rainVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.rainKey] : null;
      let phase = meta.neuLabel;
      if (driverVal != null) {
        if (meta.isPos(driverVal)) phase = meta.posLabel;
        else if (meta.isNeg(driverVal)) phase = meta.negLabel;
      }
      return { ...d, driverVal, rainVal, phase };
    });

    for (const p of phases) {
      const pRows = phaseRecords.filter((r) => r.phase === p.label);
      const count = pRows.length;
      const meanVal = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const medVal = count ? d3.median(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const minVal = count ? d3.min(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const maxVal = count ? d3.max(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const meanRain = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.rainVal) : null;
      const years = pRows.map((r) => r.year).sort().join(", ");

      tableRows.push(html`
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: ${p.color};">
            ${p.label}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${p.crit}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #334155;">
            <strong>${count} yrs</strong> ${count ? `(${years})` : ""}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: ${meanRain != null && meanRain >= 0 ? '#0369a1' : '#b91c1c'};">
            ${meanRain != null ? `${meanRain >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(meanRain)}%` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
            ${itm}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${meanVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(meanVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #475569; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${medVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(medVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #64748b; text-align: right; font-size: 0.76rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${minVal != null && maxVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(minVal)} – ${formatNumCompactShort()(maxVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
        </tr>
      `);
    }
  }

  return html`
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: inherit;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 0.74rem;">
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Driver Phase</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Numerical Threshold</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Sampled Years</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Mean Rain Anom</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Commodity</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Mean Output</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Median Output</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Observed Range</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${tableRows}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
sec32NdviChart = {

  const epochs = [
    {from: new Date("2005-09-01"), to: new Date("2006-03-31"), label: "'06 Drought"},
    {from: new Date("2010-09-01"), to: new Date("2011-09-30"), label: "'11 Famine"},
    {from: new Date("2016-09-01"), to: new Date("2017-06-30"), label: "'17 Crisis"},
    {from: new Date("2020-09-01"), to: new Date("2023-01-31"), label: "'20–22 Triple Dip"},
    {from: new Date("2023-10-01"), to: new Date("2024-05-31"), label: "'23–24 El Niño Flush"}
  ];

  return Plot.plot({

      label: "MODIS NDVI (% of Normal)",

      }),

        x: "t",

      Plot.lineY(rows, {
        x: "t",
        y: "ndvi_pct_normal",

      }),

        },

      })
    ]
  });
}

{

// Terms of Trade computation
totRows = {
  const rows = await dbPrices.query(`
    WITH g AS (
      SELECT year, month, MEDIAN(value_kes) AS goat
      FROM market_prices
      WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND (${normExpr("market")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' OR NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM market_prices m_sub
          WHERE ${normExpr("m_sub.county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
            AND ${normExpr("m_sub.market")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
            AND m_sub.product = 'Goats (Local Quality)'
        ))
        AND price_type = 'Retail' AND product = 'Goats (Local Quality)' AND unit = 'ea'
      GROUP BY year, month),
    m AS (
      SELECT year, month, MEDIAN(value_kes) AS maize
      FROM market_prices
      WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND (${normExpr("market")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' OR NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM market_prices m_sub
          WHERE ${normExpr("m_sub.county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
            AND ${normExpr("m_sub.market")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
            AND m_sub.product = 'Maize Grain (White)'
        ))
        AND price_type = 'Retail' AND product = 'Maize Grain (White)' AND unit = 'kg'
      GROUP BY year, month)
    SELECT g.year, g.month, g.goat, m.maize
    FROM g JOIN m ON g.year = m.year AND g.month = m.month
    WHERE m.maize > 0
    ORDER BY g.year, g.month`);
  const out = rows.map((d) => ({
    year: Number(d.year), month: Number(d.month),
    t: new Date(Date.UTC(Number(d.year), Number(d.month) - 1, 1)),
    goat: d.goat, maize: d.maize,
    tot: d.goat / d.maize
  }));
  let seg = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
    if (i > 0 && (out[i].t - out[i - 1].t) / 86400000 > 100) seg++;
    out[i].seg = seg;
    const startIdx = Math.max(0, i - 23);
    let peak = 0;
    for (let j = startIdx; j <= i; j++) {
      if (out[j].tot > peak) peak = out[j].tot;
    }
    out[i].peak24 = peak;
    out[i].drop24 = peak > 0 ? (out[i].tot - peak) / peak : 0;
  }
  return out;
}

// Figure 3.2b Chart Generator (Prices & Terms of Trade)
sec32PricesChart = {
  const {rows, label, ref} = pricesView;
  if (!rows || !rows.length) {
    return noDataPlaceholder(`No retail market price records for ${priceProduct} in ${county} matching the active filters.`);
  }

  // Panel A: Retail Prices
  let pPrices;
  if (priceAgg !== "Monthly lines") {
    // Summary bars: mean of the selected transform across the chosen markets, per quarter or year
    const to = d3.max(rows, (d) => d._t);
    const bucket = (d) => priceAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), Math.floor(d._t.getUTCMonth() / 3) * 3, 1);
    const step = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const agg = [...d3.rollup(rows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.v), n: v.length}), bucket)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + step[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + step[1], 1));
        return {
          x1: d0,
          x2: xEnd > dataEnd ? dataEnd : xEnd,
          partial: xEnd > dataEnd,
          v: o.v,
          n: o.n
        };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);

    const aggLabel = `${label} (${priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "annual" : "quarterly"} mean)`;
    pPrices = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 220,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null, grid: true},
      y: {
        label: aggLabel,
        grid: true,
        tickFormat: (d) => ref == null ? formatNumCompactShort()(d) : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d}%` : `${d.toFixed(1)}σ`)
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.rect(agg, {
          x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "v", inset: 1,
          fill: (d) => (ref != null && d.v < 0 ? "#16a34a" : "#2563eb"),
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.55 : 0.85,
          stroke: (d) => (ref != null && d.v < 0 ? "#15803d" : "#1d4ed8"),
          strokeWidth: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) => {
            const period = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? d.x1.getUTCFullYear() : `${d.x1.getUTCFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.x1.getUTCMonth()/3) + 1}`;
            const val = ref == null ? `${Math.round(d.v).toLocaleString()} KES` : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d.v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.v.toFixed(1)}%` : `${d.v.toFixed(2)} σ`);
            return `${period}: ${val} (mean of ${d.n} market-months${d.partial ? " — incomplete period" : ""})`;
          }
        }),
        ...(ref != null ? [Plot.ruleY([ref], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2})] : [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 0.8})]),
      ]
    });
  } else {
    // Monthly continuous line series
    const mkts = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.market))];
    const mktColors = paletteRange(mkts.length);
    pPrices = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 220,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null, grid: true},
      y: {
        label,
        grid: true,
        tickFormat: (d) => ref == null ? formatNumCompactShort()(d) : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d}%` : `${d.toFixed(1)}σ`)
      },
      color: {domain: mkts, range: mktColors, legend: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "_t", y: "v", stroke: "market", z: "seg", strokeWidth: 1.6}),
        Plot.dot(rows, {
          x: "_t", y: "v", fill: "market", r: 2.5,
          channels: {
            Market: "market",
            Date: (d) => d.period_date,
            Value: (d) => ref == null ? `${Math.round(d.v).toLocaleString()} KES` : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d.v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.v.toFixed(1)}%` : `${d.v.toFixed(2)} σ`)
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Market: true, Date: true, Value: true}}
        }),
        ...(ref != null ? [Plot.ruleY([ref], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2})] : [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 0.8})]),
      ]
    });
  }

  const panelATitle = priceView === "Raw price"
    ? `A. Retail Market Prices Across Sentinel Hubs (${priceProduct} • ${county})`
    : priceView === "Change vs year earlier"
    ? `A. Year-on-Year Retail Price Inflation (% YoY Change • ${priceProduct} • ${county})`
    : `A. Seasonal Anomaly (Departure from Month Climatology in Standard Deviations • ${priceProduct} • ${county})`;

  if (!totRows.length) {
    return html`
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
          ${panelATitle}
        </div>
        ${pPrices}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // Panel B: Terms of Trade (ToT)
  const totMed = d3.median(totRows, (d) => d.tot) || 50;
  let pTot;
  if (priceAgg !== "Monthly lines") {
    // ToT summary bars aggregated by quarter or year
    const toToT = d3.max(totRows, (d) => d.t);
    const bucketToT = (d) => priceAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d.year, 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d.year, Math.floor((d.month - 1) / 3) * 3, 1);
    const stepToT = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEndToT = new Date(Date.UTC(toToT.getUTCFullYear(), toToT.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const aggToT = [...d3.rollup(totRows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.tot), n: v.length}), bucketToT)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + stepToT[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + stepToT[1], 1));
        return {
          x1: d0,
          x2: xEnd > dataEndToT ? dataEndToT : xEnd,
          partial: xEnd > dataEndToT,
          tot: o.v,
          n: o.n
        };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);

    pTot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 190,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: "Date", grid: true},
      y: {label: `Mean kg Maize / Goat (${priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "Year" : "Quarter"})`, grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(100, (d3.max(aggToT, (d) => d.tot) || 80) + 10)]},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([totMed], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        Plot.text([totMed], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => `Normal Median (~${Math.round(totMed)} kg/goat)`, fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4}),
        Plot.ruleY([25], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeWidth: 1.4, strokeDasharray: "2,2"}),
        Plot.text([25], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => "Emergency Collapse Threshold (25 kg)", fill: "#dc2626", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4, fontWeight: 700}),
        Plot.rect(aggToT, {
          x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "tot", inset: 1,
          fill: (d) => d.tot <= 25 ? "#dc2626" : (d.tot < totMed ? "#d97706" : "#059669"),
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.55 : 0.85,
          stroke: (d) => d.tot <= 25 ? "#b91c1c" : (d.tot < totMed ? "#b45309" : "#047857"),
          strokeWidth: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) => {
            const period = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? d.x1.getUTCFullYear() : `${d.x1.getUTCFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.x1.getUTCMonth()/3) + 1}`;
            return `${period}: ${d.tot.toFixed(1)} kg maize / goat (mean of ${d.n} months${d.partial ? " — incomplete period" : ""})`;
          }
        }),
      ]
    });
  } else {
    // ToT continuous line
    pTot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 190,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: "Date", grid: true},
      y: {label: "kg Maize / Goat", grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(100, (d3.max(totRows, (d) => d.tot) || 80) + 10)]},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([totMed], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        Plot.text([totMed], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => `Normal Median (~${Math.round(totMed)} kg/goat)`, fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4}),
        Plot.ruleY([25], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeWidth: 1.4, strokeDasharray: "2,2"}),
        Plot.text([25], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => "Emergency Collapse Threshold (25 kg)", fill: "#dc2626", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4, fontWeight: 700}),
        Plot.lineY(totRows, {x: "t", y: "tot", z: "seg", stroke: "#d97706", strokeWidth: 2}),
        Plot.dot(totRows, {
          x: "t", y: "tot", fill: "#d97706", stroke: "#ffffff", strokeWidth: 1, r: 3,
          channels: {
            Month: (d) => `${d.year}-${String(d.month).padStart(2, "0")}`,
            "Terms of Trade": (d) => `${d.tot.toFixed(1)} kg maize / goat`,
            "Drop vs 24m Peak": (d) => d.drop24 != null ? `${d3.format(".1%")(d.drop24)} (24m Peak: ${d.peak24.toFixed(1)} kg)` : "—",
            "Goat Price": (d) => `${Math.round(d.goat).toLocaleString()} KES`,
            "Maize Price": (d) => `${Math.round(d.maize)} KES/kg`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Month: true, "Terms of Trade": true, "Drop vs 24m Peak": true, "Goat Price": true, "Maize Price": true}}
        })
      ]
    });
  }

  const panelBTitle = `B. Pastoral Terms of Trade (ToT) Purchasing Power: 1 Medium Goat → Kilograms of Maize Grain (${priceAgg === "Monthly lines" ? "Monthly" : (priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "Annual Mean" : "Quarterly Mean")})`;

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
        ${panelATitle}
      </div>
      ${pPrices}
      <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-top: 0.4rem;">
        ${panelBTitle}
      </div>
      ${pTot}
    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Figure 4.4
{
  [county, priceProduct, priceView, priceMarkets, priceAgg, sec32PricesChart];
  const host = document.getElementById("plotPricesHost");
  if (host && sec32PricesChart) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec32PricesChart);
  }
  const footerHost = document.getElementById("fig44FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Retail commodity price dynamics and pastoral Terms of Trade purchasing power in ${county}.`,
      footerHost,
      {
        fig: "4.4",
        filename: `${county}_prices_and_terms_of_trade`,
        data: totRows.length ? totRows : (pricesView.rows || pricesSeg),
        about: `Monthly retail food and livestock prices from the FEWS NET Data Warehouse (USAID), marketpricefacts, across sentinel county markets (KES, 2008–2026). Terms of Trade (ToT) is DERIVED HERE, not a published series: median goat price (KES/head) divided by median maize-grain price (KES/kg) for the same county-month. Because it is a ratio, a fall can mean cheaper livestock OR dearer grain — opposite implications — so interpret it against the two price legs, not on its own. Severe purchasing power collapses (>50% to >68%) hold on monthly series evaluated against trailing 24-month peaks (e.g. Aug 2011: −68.1%, Feb 2023: −68.1% at the end of the 2020–23 drought); annual averaging dampens crisis depths. FEWS NET redistributes third-party series in the warehouse under the originating provider's terms; identify the collecting agency before republishing any series.`,
        meta: {County: county, Product: priceProduct, View: priceView, Aggregation: priceAgg}
      }
    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}

// Table 3.2: Historical Drought Episodes Summary
sec32Table = {
  const shockRows = [
    {
      epoch: "2005–2006 Drought",
      driver: "La Niña + Neutral IOD",
      ndviMin: "58% of normal",
      totMin: "28 kg / goat (pre-series)",
      impact: "Severe forage deficit across northern ASALs; ~30% livestock mortality."
    },
    {
      epoch: "2010–2011 Famine Peak",
      driver: "Strong La Niña + Negative IOD",
      ndviMin: "44% of normal",
      totMin: "28.7 kg / goat (-68.1% vs peak)",
      impact: "Historic Horn of Africa famine crisis; IPC Phase 4 Emergency declared; widespread herd mortality."
    },
    {
      epoch: "2016–2017 ASAL Crisis",
      driver: "Consecutive failed rains (La Niña onset)",
      ndviMin: "52% of normal",
      totMin: "43.9 kg / goat (-41.2% vs peak)",
      impact: "National drought disaster declared; massive emergency livestock off-take and water trucking."
    },
    {
      epoch: "2020–2023 Drought (5 failed seasons)",
      driver: "Historic 3-year consecutive La Niña (5 failed seasons)",
      ndviMin: "37% of normal",
      totMin: "25.1 kg / goat (-68.1% vs peak)",
      impact: "Prolonged pasture collapse; over 2.5 million livestock died across ASALs; deepest purchasing power trough reached in Feb 2023."
    },
    {
      epoch: "2023–2024 El Niño Rebound",
      driver: "Super El Niño (+2.0 °C) + Record Positive IOD",
      ndviMin: "148% of normal (surge)",
      totMin: "68+ kg / goat (up to 127 kg)",
      impact: "Catastrophic flash floods replaced by rapid pasture flush; slow herd reconstitution due to prior stock losses."
    }
  ];

  return html`
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: inherit;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 0.74rem;">
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Drought / Climate Epoch</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Ocean Teleconnection Trigger</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: center;">Min Pasture NDVI</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: center;">Min Terms of Trade</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Humanitarian &amp; Pastoral Outcome</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${shockRows.map((r) => html`
          <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${r.epoch}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #0369a1; font-weight: 600;">${r.driver}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: ${r.ndviMin.startsWith('1') ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c'};">${r.ndviMin}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: ${r.totMin.startsWith('6') ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c'};">${r.totMin}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.4;">${r.impact}</td>
          </tr>
        `)}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}

// Mount Table 3.2
{
  [county, sec32Table];
  const host = document.getElementById("table32Host");
  if (host && sec32Table) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec32Table);
  }
}

// Figure 3.3 Subcounty Choropleth Map
sec33Map = {
  if (!countySubs || !countySubs.length) return noDataPlaceholder("No subcounty geometries available for " + county);
  
  const featuresWithData = countySubs.map((f) => {
    const pcode = f.properties.admin2_pcode || f.properties.adm2_pcode;
    const r = expByPcode.get(pcode);
    return {
      ...f,
      _val: r ? r.val : 0,
      _pop: r ? r.pop_exposed : 0,
      _pct: r ? r.pop_pct : 0,
      _obs: (r && r.observed_pct != null) ? r.observed_pct : null,
      _name: f.properties.admin2_name || f.properties.adm2_name
    };
  });

  return Plot.plot({
    width: 520,
    height: 460,
    projection: "mercator",
    color: {
      type: "quantile",
      n: 5,
      scheme: "Blues",
      label: `${expMetric} (${expCfg.unit})`,
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(featuresWithData, {
        fill: "_val",
        stroke: "#475569",
        strokeWidth: 0.75,
        channels: {
          Subcounty: "_name",
          Exposure: (d) => `${expCfg.fmt(d._val)} ${expCfg.unit}`,
          "Pop Exposed": (d) => `${d3.format(",.0f")(d._pop)} (${d3.format(".1%")(d._pct)})`,
          ...(expIsGfm ? {"SAR Radar Coverage": (d) => d._obs != null ? d3.format(".1%")(Math.max(0, d._obs)) : "—"} : {})
        },
        tip: {format: {fill: false, Subcounty: true, Exposure: true, "Pop Exposed": true, ...(expIsGfm ? {"SAR Radar Coverage": true} : {})}}
      }),
      Plot.geo(countyA1 ? [countyA1] : [], {
        stroke: "#0f172a",
        strokeWidth: 1.8,
        fill: "none"
      }),
      Plot.text(featuresWithData, Plot.centroid({
        text: (d) => `${d._name}\n${expCfg.fmt(d._val)}`,
        fill: "#0f172a",
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 2.5,
        paintOrder: "stroke",
        fontSize: 10,
        fontWeight: 600
      }))
    ]
  });
}

// Mount Figure 4.5

sec33Table = {
```

```{ojs}
// Mount Section 4.4 Controls
{
  [viewof rwHazardFilter];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec34ControlsHost");
  if (host) {
    host.replaceChildren(
      html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem 1.6rem; align-items: center; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
        <div style="min-width: 240px;">${viewof rwHazardFilter}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; line-height: 1.35; max-width: 520px;">
          UN OCHA ReliefWeb county-tagged situation reports (2010–2026). First-match hazard categorization: Drought &rarr; Flood &rarr; Epidemic &rarr; Other.
        </div>
      </div>`
    );
  }
}

sec34RwFiltered = {
  const minYear = 2010;
  let data = rwByYear.filter((d) => d.year >= minYear);
  if (rwHazardFilter && rwHazardFilter !== "All disaster types") {
    data = data.filter((d) => d.cat === rwHazardFilter);
  }
  return data;
}

// Figure 4.6 Chart Generator
sec34RwChart = {
  if (!sec34RwFiltered.length) {
    return noDataPlaceholder(`No ReliefWeb disaster reports recorded for ${county} matching the active filters.`);
  }

  const minYear = 2010;
  const yEnd = d3.max(sec34RwFiltered, (d) => d.year) || 2026;
  const ymax = d3.max([...d3.rollup(sec34RwFiltered, (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.n), (d) => d.year)].map(([, n]) => n)) || 1;

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 880,
    height: 300,
    marginLeft: 65,
    marginRight: 35,
    x: {
      domain: [minYear - 0.5, yEnd + 0.5],
      ticks: d3.range(minYear, yEnd + 1),
      tickFormat: "d",
      label: null,
      grid: false
    },
    y: {
      label: "Published Humanitarian Reports / Appeals",
      grid: true,
      domain: [0, Math.max(5, ymax * 1.15)]
    },
    color: {
      domain: ["Drought", "Flood", "Epidemic", "Other"],
      range: ["#d95f0e", "#2563eb", "#7b3294", "#94a3b8"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(sec34RwFiltered, {
        x1: (d) => d.year - 0.45,
        x2: (d) => d.year + 0.45,
        y: "n",
        fill: "cat",
        rx: 2,
        inset: 0.5,
        channels: {
          Year: "year",
          Category: "cat",
          Reports: "n"
        },
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Category: true, Reports: true}}
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 1})
    ]
  });

  return chart;
}

// Mount Figure 4.6 and Footer
{
  [county, rwHazardFilter, sec34RwChart];
  const host = document.getElementById("plotReliefWebHost");
  if (host && sec34RwChart) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec34RwChart);
  }
  const footerHost = document.getElementById("fig46FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Annual frequency of UN OCHA ReliefWeb disaster situation reports and emergency appeals in ${county}.`,
      footerHost,
      {
        fig: "4.6",
        filename: `${county}_reliefweb_disaster_reports`,
        data: rwCty,
        about: `County-tagged humanitarian and situation reports from UN OCHA ReliefWeb (15,736 rows across all 47 counties, 2010–2026). Each report is assigned deterministically by first match: Drought → Flood → Epidemic → Other. Report volume reflects institutional reporting attention, emergency appeal cycles, and international media attention in addition to physical hazard severity.`,
        meta: {County: county, Filter: rwHazardFilter, MinYear: 2010, TotalCountyReports: rwCty.length}

// Table 4.5 Data & Generator
sec34RwTableRows = {
  const minYear = 2010;
  return rwCty.filter((d) => {
    const y = +d.date.slice(0, 4);
    if (y < minYear) return false;
    if (rwHazardFilter && rwHazardFilter !== "All disaster types") {
      return rwCat(d.disaster_type) === rwHazardFilter;
    }
    return true;
  });
}

sec34RwTable = {
  if (!sec34RwTableRows.length) {
    return html`<div style="color: #64748b; font-style: italic; padding: 1.25rem 0.5rem;">No disaster reports matching active criteria in ${county}.</div>`;
  }

  const topRows = sec34RwTableRows.slice(0, 15);
  const rowsHtml = topRows.map((d) => {
    const cat = rwCat(d.disaster_type);
    const badgeColor = cat === "Drought" ? "background: #fed7aa; color: #9a3412;"
      : cat === "Flood" ? "background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af;"
      : cat === "Epidemic" ? "background: #e9d5ff; color: #6b21a8;"
      : "background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569;";

    return html`<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
      <td style="white-space: nowrap; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #334155; padding: 7px 10px;">${d.date}</td>
      <td style="padding: 7px 10px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; ${badgeColor} display: inline-block;">
          ${cat}
        </span>
      </td>
      <td style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 10px;">${d.source || "—"}</td>
      <td style="padding: 7px 10px;">
        <a href="${d.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: #0284c7; text-decoration: underline; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-block;">
          ${d.title}
        </a>
        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-left: 4px;">&#x2197;</span>
      </td>
    </tr>`;
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;">
      <table class="table table-sm table-hover" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">
        <thead>
```
