// Reactive selection for Section 2 Analogue Year
viewof sec4SelectedYear = {
  const defaultYr = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length)
    ? analogueYears[0].year
    : 2003;
  const input = Inputs.input(defaultYr);
  return input;
}

{
  window._setSec4SelectedYear = (y) => {
    if (viewof sec4SelectedYear) {
      viewof sec4SelectedYear.value = Number(y);
      viewof sec4SelectedYear.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
    }
  };
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FIGURE 2.1: TERCILE DISTRIBUTION & FORECAST PLUME MACHINERY
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

viewof matchingCriterion = {
  const modes = [
    { 
      id: "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)", 
      label: "Full Trajectory", 
      badge: "Balanced (50/50)",
      desc: "Balances observed pre-season (JAS) ocean momentum with projected OND peak intensity to find full-lifecycle analogues." 
    },
    { 
      id: "Lead-in Observed (JAS)", 
      label: "Lead-in Observed (JAS)", 
      badge: "Pre-Season Only",
      desc: "Matches solely July–September observed Pacific & Indian Ocean states, without assuming the multi-model forecast will verify." 
    },
    { 
      id: "Projected Season (OND Plume)", 
      label: "Projected Season (OND Plume)", 
      badge: "Peak Warming (+3.1°C)",
      desc: "Filters for rare historical years that reached the extreme peak warming currently projected by dynamical models." 
    }
  ];
  let currentVal = "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)";

  const container = html`
    <div style="width: 100%;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.45rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
          Analogue Matching Mode:
        </span>
        <span id="critBadge" style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0284c7; background: #e0f2fe; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px;">
          Balanced (50/50)
        </span>
      </div>

      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px;">
        ${modes.map(m => {
          const isAct = m.id === currentVal;
          const btn = html`
            <button 
              type="button" 
              class="btn-driver-tab ${isAct ? 'active' : ''}" 
              style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 4px; text-align: center; border-radius: 5px; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.25; ${isAct ? 'background: #0284c7 !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: #0369a1 !important; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.3);' : 'background: transparent; color: #475569; border-color: transparent;'}"
              title="${m.desc}"
            >
              ${m.label}
            </button>
          `;
          btn.onclick = () => {
            currentVal = m.id;
            container.value = currentVal;
            container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
            container.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => {
              b.classList.remove("active");
              b.style.background = "transparent";
              b.style.color = "#475569";
              b.style.borderColor = "transparent";
              b.style.boxShadow = "none";
            });
            btn.classList.add("active");
            btn.style.background = "#0284c7";
            btn.style.color = "#fff";
            btn.style.borderColor = "#0369a1";
            btn.style.boxShadow = "0 1px 3px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.3)";
            
            const descEl = container.querySelector("#critDesc");
            if (descEl) descEl.textContent = m.desc;
            const badgeEl = container.querySelector("#critBadge");
            if (badgeEl) badgeEl.textContent = m.badge;
          };
          return btn;
        })}
      </div>

      <div id="critDesc" style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.35; font-style: italic; padding: 0 2px;">
        ${modes[0].desc}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  container.value = currentVal;
  return container;
}

// Mount Figure 2.1 Controls
{
  const host = document.getElementById("fig21ControlsHost");
  if (host && viewof matchingCriterion) {
    host.replaceChildren(viewof matchingCriterion);
  }
}

// Generate Figure 2.1 Output (Empirical Tercile Distribution conditioned on Analogues)
sec4TercileView = {
  const o = selectedOutlook ? selectedOutlook.outlook : null;
  const dots = selectedOutlook ? selectedOutlook.dots : [];
  const counts = o ? o.counts : { Wet: 0, Near: 0, Dry: 0 };
  const n = o ? o.n : (analogueYears ? analogueYears.length : 8);
  const pWet = n > 0 ? Math.round((counts.Wet / n) * 100) : 0;
  const pNear = n > 0 ? Math.round((counts.Near / n) * 100) : 0;
  const pDry = n > 0 ? Math.round((counts.Dry / n) * 100) : 0;
  const modal = o ? o.modal : "Near";
  const countyName = (selectedOutlook && selectedOutlook.countyName) || county || "Marsabit";
  const climMean = (selectedOutlook && selectedOutlook.climMean != null) 
    ? selectedOutlook.climMean 
    : (dots.find(d => d.clim_mean != null)?.clim_mean || null);

  const totalSample = (analogueYears && analogueYears[0]?.totalSample) || 45;
  const activeCrit = matchingCriterion || "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)";

  // Partition analogues into terciles
  const wetDots = dots.filter(d => d.tercile === "Wet");
  const nearDots = dots.filter(d => d.tercile === "Near");
  const dryDots = dots.filter(d => d.tercile === "Dry");

  const renderAnaloguePills = (groupDots, borderCol) => {
    if (groupDots.length === 0) {
      return html`<div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic; padding: 0.5rem 0; text-align: center;">0 analogue seasons</div>`;
    }
    return html`
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;">
        ${groupDots.map(d => {
          const isSelected = sec4SelectedYear === d.year;
          const anomText = d.anomaly_pct != null ? `${d.anomaly_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(d.anomaly_pct)}%` : '';
          const ptotText = d.ptot != null ? `${Math.round(d.ptot)} mm` : '';
          const rankText = d.rank != null ? `#${d.rank}` : '';
          const distText = d.distStr != null ? `D=${d.distStr}` : '';
          
          const btn = html`
            <button
              type="button"
              style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 5px; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: all 0.15s ease; border: ${isSelected ? '2px solid #0284c7' : '1px solid ' + borderCol}; background: ${isSelected ? '#e0f2fe' : '#ffffff'}; box-shadow: ${isSelected ? '0 1px 4px rgba(2,132,199,0.25)' : 'none'};"
              title="${rankText} ${d.year} (${distText}): ${anomText} anomaly (${ptotText}) in ${countyName}. Click to inspect rainfall map in Figure 2.2."
            >
              <div style="display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px;">
                <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">${rankText} ${d.year}</span>
                <span style="font-size: 0.66rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">(${distText})</span>
              </div>
              <div style="font-size: 0.71rem; font-weight: 700; color: ${d.tercile === 'Wet' ? '#0284c7' : d.tercile === 'Dry' ? '#d97706' : '#475569'}; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
                ${anomText}
              </div>
            </button>
          `;
          btn.onclick = () => {
            viewof sec4SelectedYear.value = d.year;
            viewof sec4SelectedYear.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
          };
          return btn;
        })}
      </div>
    `;
  };

  return html`
    <div style="padding: 0.35rem 0;">
      
      <!-- County & Climatology Context Strip -->
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.45rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem;">
        <div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">${countyName} County</span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: #64748b; margin-left: 4px;">• OND Rainfall Outcomes</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: #475569;">
          Normal Baseline (1991–2020): <strong>${climMean != null ? `${Math.round(climMean)} mm` : '161 mm'}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- 100% Horizontal Stacked Probability Bar with Climatology Markers -->
      <div style="margin-bottom: 0.85rem;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.3rem;">
          <span style="font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;">
            Empirical Tercile Probability Distribution
          </span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.70rem; color: #64748b;">
            Dashed ticks: 33.3% climatological equal odds
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style="position: relative; height: 26px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; background: #e2e8f0; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">
          <!-- Wet Segment -->
          <div style="width: ${pWet}%; background: #0284c7; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 800; transition: width 0.3s ease; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;" title="Wetter than normal: ${counts.Wet}/${n} (${pWet}%)">
            ${pWet >= 12 ? `${pWet}% Wetter` : (pWet > 0 ? `${pWet}%` : '')}
          </div>
          <!-- Near Segment -->
          <div style="width: ${pNear}%; background: #475569; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 800; transition: width 0.3s ease; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;" title="Near normal: ${counts.Near}/${n} (${pNear}%)">
            ${pNear >= 12 ? `${pNear}% Near` : (pNear > 0 ? `${pNear}%` : '')}
          </div>
          <!-- Dry Segment -->
          <div style="width: ${pDry}%; background: #d97706; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 800; transition: width 0.3s ease; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;" title="Drier than normal: ${counts.Dry}/${n} (${pDry}%)">
            ${pDry >= 12 ? `${pDry}% Drier` : (pDry > 0 ? `${pDry}%` : '')}
          </div>

          <!-- 33.3% Reference Marker -->
          <div style="position: absolute; left: 33.33%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; border-left: 2px dashed #ffffff; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.85;"></div>
          <!-- 66.6% Reference Marker -->
          <div style="position: absolute; left: 66.67%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; border-left: 2px dashed #ffffff; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.85;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- 3-Column Scenario Layout (Side-by-Side) with Embedded Analogue Years -->
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.60rem; margin-bottom: 0.85rem;">
        
        <!-- Column 1: Wetter -->
        <div style="background: ${modal === 'Wet' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#f8fafc'}; border: 1px solid ${modal === 'Wet' ? '#0284c7' : '#e2e8f0'}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.60rem 0.55rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
          <div style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.40rem; margin-bottom: 0.45rem;">
            <div style="font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0284c7; text-transform: uppercase;">Wetter</div>
            <div style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0284c7; margin: 1px 0;">${counts.Wet} of ${n}</div>
            <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; color: #0369a1; font-weight: 600;">${pWet}% (&gt; +0.43&sigma;)</div>
          </div>
          ${renderAnaloguePills(wetDots, '#bae6fd')}
        </div>

        <!-- Column 2: Near Normal -->
        <div style="background: ${modal === 'Near' ? '#f1f5f9' : '#f8fafc'}; border: 1px solid ${modal === 'Near' ? '#475569' : '#e2e8f0'}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.60rem 0.55rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
          <div style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.40rem; margin-bottom: 0.45rem;">
            <div style="font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 800; color: #475569; text-transform: uppercase;">Near Normal</div>
            <div style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #334155; margin: 1px 0;">${counts.Near} of ${n}</div>
            <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600;">${pNear}% (&plusmn;0.43&sigma;)</div>
          </div>
          ${renderAnaloguePills(nearDots, '#cbd5e1')}
        </div>

        <!-- Column 3: Drier -->
        <div style="background: ${modal === 'Dry' ? '#fffbeb' : '#f8fafc'}; border: 1px solid ${modal === 'Dry' ? '#d97706' : '#e2e8f0'}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.60rem 0.55rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
          <div style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.40rem; margin-bottom: 0.45rem;">
            <div style="font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 800; color: #d97706; text-transform: uppercase;">Drier</div>
            <div style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #d97706; margin: 1px 0;">${counts.Dry} of ${n}</div>
            <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; color: #b45309; font-weight: 600;">${pDry}% (&lt; &minus;0.43&sigma;)</div>
          </div>
          ${renderAnaloguePills(dryDots, '#fde68a')}
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- Actionable Scenario Advisory Callout -->
      <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-left: 4px solid #0284c7; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.60rem 0.80rem; font-size: 0.74rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.45;">
        <strong>Scenario Planning Interpretation (N = ${n} Analogue Seasons):</strong>
        Empirical analogue distributions ground dynamic models in Kenyan climate history. Because ocean configurations are rare (${n} of ${totalSample} candidate seasons, 1981–2025), these terciles represent empirical scenarios rather than deterministic forecasts. 
        In <strong>${countyName}</strong>, the modal scenario is <strong>${modal === 'Wet' ? 'Wetter than normal' : modal === 'Dry' ? 'Drier than normal' : 'Near normal'}</strong> (${counts[modal]} of ${n} seasons).
        <em>Click any historical year pill above to explore its spatial rainfall footprint in Figure 2.2 below.</em>
      </div>

    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Figure 2.1
{
  [county, selectedOutlook, sec4SelectedYear, matchingCriterion, sec4TercileView];
  const host = document.getElementById("fig21TercileHost");
  if (host && sec4TercileView) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec4TercileView);
  }
  const fHost = document.getElementById("fig21FooterHost");
  if (fHost) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Empirical tercile probability distribution for ${county} based on ${analogueYears.length} nearest-neighbor ocean analogues ranked in standardized predictor space (${matchingCriterion || 'Full Trajectory'}).`,
      fHost,
      {
        fig: "2.1",
        filename: `${county}_ond_analogue_tercile_probabilities`,
        data: selectedOutlook?.dots || [],
        about: `Historical Short Rains (OND) rainfall outcomes classified into climatological terciles (1991–2020 WMO baseline) across the ${analogueYears.length} nearest analogue seasons. Natural frequencies prevent false precision.`,
        meta: { County: county, Phase: outlookForecast.phase, Analogues: analogueYears.length, Criterion: matchingCriterion }
      }
    );
    fHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FIGURE 2.2: HISTORICAL ANALOGUE MULTI-HAZARD DIAGNOSTICS & TRAJECTORY CURVE
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

viewof fig22View = Inputs.radio(["Multi-hazard profile", "Ocean-state curve (Current vs Analogue)", "County spatial context"], {
  value: "Multi-hazard profile",
  label: "View:"
})

// Control Bar: Analogue Year Pills + View Selector
sec4PillBar = {
  const analogues = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length) ? analogueYears : [];
  
  const pills = analogues.map((a) => {
    const y = a.year;
    const isAct = sec4SelectedYear === y;
    const roni = a.roni_pred != null ? a.roni_pred : (rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) || 0);
    const roniStr = `${roni >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${roni.toFixed(1)}°C`;
    const btn = html`
      <button
        class="analogue-pill ${isAct ? 'active' : ''}"
        style="cursor: pointer;"
        title="Rank #${a.rank} &bull; Standardized distance D = ${a.distStr} &bull; Click to inspect"
      >
        #${a.rank} ${y} (${roniStr} RONI &bull; D=${a.distStr})
      </button>
    `;
    btn.onclick = () => {
      viewof sec4SelectedYear.value = y;
      viewof sec4SelectedYear.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
    };
    return btn;
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; width: 100%;">
      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
          Historical Analogue Years:
          <button
            type="button"
            title="Standardized distance D measures similarity in joint Pacific (RONI) and Indian Ocean (DMI) space, normalized by each basin's standard deviation (1991–2020) so neither basin dominates. D < 1.0 indicates an exceptionally close historical analogue."
            style="background: #e0f2fe; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; color: #0284c7; border-radius: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: help; padding: 0;"
            onclick="alert('Standardized Distance (D):\\n\\nMeasures multi-basin similarity between target conditions and historical years across both the Pacific (RONI) and Indian Ocean (DMI).\\n\\nBecause Pacific SST anomalies have ~10.6× higher variance than Indian Ocean DMI anomalies, raw Euclidean distance would ignore the Indian Ocean Dipole. Standardizing by 1991–2020 standard deviations gives both basins balanced physical weight.\\n\\n• D < 1.0: Exceptionally close analogue\\n• 1.0 ≤ D < 2.0: Moderate analogue\\n• D ≥ 2.0: Distant analogue')"
          >
            ?
          </button>
        </span>
        <div class="analogue-pill-group" style="display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
          ${pills}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 0.45rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
        <div>${viewof fig22View}</div>
        <button class="btn-dataset-jump" onclick="jumpToDataset('driver_indices')">
          Analogue Index Spec &rarr;
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Analogue Selector Control Bar
{
  [analogueYears, sec4SelectedYear, viewof fig22View, sec4PillBar];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec4AnalogueSelectorHost");
  if (host && sec4PillBar) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec4PillBar);
  }
}

// Compute metrics for selected analogue year
sec4Profile = {
  const y = sec4SelectedYear;
  const aMatch = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length) ? analogueYears.find((d) => d.year === y) : null;
  const rank = aMatch ? aMatch.rank : null;
  const distStr = aMatch ? aMatch.distStr : null;
  
  // 1. Ocean state
  const roni = aMatch?.roni_pred != null ? aMatch.roni_pred : (rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) || 0);
  const dmi = aMatch?.dmi_pred != null ? aMatch.dmi_pred : (rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0);
  const ensoTag = roni >= 1.5 ? "Very Strong El Niño" : roni >= 1.0 ? "Strong El Niño" : roni >= 0.5 ? "Moderate El Niño" : roni <= -1.0 ? "Strong La Niña" : roni <= -0.5 ? "Moderate La Niña" : "Neutral ENSO";
  const iodTag = dmi >= 0.4 ? "Positive IOD (+Dipole)" : dmi <= -0.4 ? "Negative IOD (-Dipole)" : "Neutral IOD";

  // 2. CHIRPS rainfall
  const ondRow = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "OND");
  const mamRow = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "MAM");
  const ondVal = ondRow ? Math.round(ondRow.value_mean) : null;
  const mamVal = mamRow ? Math.round(mamRow.value_mean) : null;
  const ondAnom = ondVal != null && sec31ClimOND > 0 ? Math.round(((ondVal - sec31ClimOND) / sec31ClimOND) * 100) : null;
  const mamAnom = mamVal != null && sec31ClimMAM > 0 ? Math.round(((mamVal - sec31ClimMAM) / sec31ClimMAM) * 100) : null;

  // 3. Pasture NDVI
  const ndviRows = ndviCty.filter((d) => {
    const yr = Number(d.date.slice(0, 4));
    const mo = Number(d.date.slice(5, 7));
    return (yr === y && mo >= 10) || (yr === y + 1 && mo <= 2);
  });
  const ndviAvg = ndviRows.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(ndviRows, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal)) : null;

  // 4. Terms of Trade / market (NDMA / FEWS NET retail monitoring started in 2008 for 20 ASAL counties)
  const totList = totRows.filter((d) => d.year === y);
  const totAvg = totList.length ? (d3.median(totList, (d) => d.tot)).toFixed(1) : null;

  // 5. Synthesis text
  let synTitle = `Table 2.1 • Two-Season Compound Historical Outcome Record (${y}: MAM + OND)`;
  let synDesc = "";
  let synPrecedent = "";

  if (ondAnom != null && mamAnom != null) {
    const mamSign = mamAnom >= 0 ? `+${mamAnom}%` : `${mamAnom}%`;
    const ondSign = ondAnom >= 0 ? `+${ondAnom}%` : `${ondAnom}%`;

    if (mamAnom >= 10 && ondAnom >= 10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, ${county} experienced consecutive wet seasons: the March–May (MAM) Long Rains were heavy (${mamSign} anomaly), followed by high October–December (OND) Short Rains (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm total). This compound rainfall surge triggered substantial pastoral pasture flush and bumper agricultural output, though localized riverine flash flooding and road infrastructure severance were observed in low-lying subcounties.`;
      synPrecedent = `Consecutive wet seasons provide significant forage recovery and recharge municipal water pans, but county disaster committees must pre-position water purification chemicals and repair damaged road culverts.`;
    } else if (mamAnom >= 10 && ondAnom < -10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, the March–May (MAM) Long Rains produced a strong positive buffer (${mamSign} anomaly, ${mamVal} mm), which cushioned ${county} against subsequent Short Rains (OND) dryness (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm). Rangeland forage held through early dry spells due to adequate soil moisture reserves accumulated earlier in the year.`;
      synPrecedent = `A favorable Long Rains season acts as an essential ecological and economic shock-absorber, preventing acute famine declarations even when the subsequent Short Rains underperform.`;
    } else if (mamAnom < -10 && ondAnom >= 10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, an initial Long Rains (MAM) deficit (${mamSign} anomaly) was rapidly broken by intense Short Rains (OND) rainfall (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm total). Vegetative browse and pasture NDVI rebounded rapidly, transitioning livestock herds from severe forage stress into lush pasture conditions within two dekads.`;
      synPrecedent = `Sudden heavy rainfall following dry spells creates severe hypothermia risk for weakened livestock and triggers epizootic disease vectors (CCPP and RVF). Pre-emptive ring-vaccination and shelter protection are required.`;
    } else if (mamAnom < -10 && ondAnom < -10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, ${county} suffered a compound multi-season drought: both the MAM Long Rains (${mamSign} anomaly) and OND Short Rains (${ondSign} anomaly) failed. Pasture biomass collapsed, Terms of Trade plunged as livestock market prices crashed relative to staple maize, and county emergency response required emergency water trucking and livestock feed subsidies.`;
      synPrecedent = `Multi-season consecutive drought is the primary driver of catastrophic herd depletion in pastoral ASALs. Commercial off-take triggers must activate early during the first season of failure.`;
    } else {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, seasonal rainfall tracked near long-term climatological medians in ${county} (MAM: ${mamSign}; OND: ${ondSign}, ${ondVal} mm total). Agricultural production and rangeland forage dynamics exhibited stable baseline performance without severe acute shock indicators.`;
      synPrecedent = `Near-normal seasons provide ideal windows for strategic asset building, rangeland reseeding, and maintenance of water pans and irrigation canals.`;
    }
  } else {
    synDesc = `Historical records for analogue year ${y} document an equatorial Pacific ocean state of ${roni >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${roni.toFixed(2)} °C (RONI) paired with an Indian Ocean Dipole index of ${dmi >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${dmi.toFixed(2)} °C (HadISST).`;
    synPrecedent = `Compare localized historical impacts against current seasonal advisories issued by the County Director of Meteorology (CDM).`;
  }

  return {
    year: y,
    rank, distStr,
    roni, dmi, ensoTag, iodTag,
    ondVal, ondAnom, mamVal, mamAnom,
    ndviAvg, totAvg,
    synTitle, synDesc, synPrecedent
  };
}

// Render Dynamic Content in Figure 2.2 Host
sec4Figure22View = {
  const p = sec4Profile;
  if (!p) return html`<div>Loading analogue profile...</div>`;

  // VIEW 1: MULTI-HAZARD DIAGNOSTIC PROFILE
  if (fig22View === "Multi-hazard profile") {
    const rainColor = p.ondAnom != null && p.ondAnom >= 0 ? "#0284c7" : "#b91c1c";
    const rainText = p.ondAnom != null ? `${p.ondAnom >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${p.ondAnom}% vs Normal` : "—";
    const rainSub = p.ondVal != null ? `${p.ondVal} mm total recorded in ${p.year} (CHIRPS)` : "Historical rainfall records";

    const pastureColor = p.ndviAvg != null && p.ndviAvg >= 100 ? "#16a34a" : "#b91c1c";
    const pastureText = p.ndviAvg != null ? `${p.ndviAvg}% of Normal` : "Pre-MODIS Era";
    const pastureSub = p.ndviAvg != null
      ? (p.ndviAvg >= 110 ? `Lush pasture flush observed in ${p.year}` : p.ndviAvg <= 90 ? `Vegetative forage deficit across rangelands` : `Adequate pasture browse across grazing zones`)
      : "MODIS 250m continuous record starts Feb 2002";

    const totText = p.totAvg != null ? `${p.totAvg} kg / goat` : "No Data (Pre-2008)";
    const totSub = p.totAvg != null
      ? (Number(p.totAvg) <= 25 ? `Severe purchasing power stress in ${p.year}` : `NDMA retail market monitoring (${p.year})`)
      : "Market price monitoring began 2008 (20 ASAL counties)";

    return html`
      <div>
        <div style="background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-left: 4px solid #d97706; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #92400e; line-height: 1.45;">
          <strong>Historical Analogue Precedent, NOT a Deterministic Forecast for 2026:</strong> 
          The cards below record observed empirical conditions for <strong>${p.year}</strong> in ${county}. They demonstrate how physical shocks propagated during a past season with similar ocean forcing — they do <em>not</em> represent a guaranteed prediction for the upcoming season. For official operational forecasts, refer to Section 2.4 (KMSA advisories).
        </div>

        <div class="analogue-profile-grid" id="analogue-metrics-grid">
          <div class="profile-stat-box">
            <div class="profile-stat-label">Observed ${p.year} Ocean State</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-val" id="an-stat-ocean">RONI ${p.roni >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${p.roni.toFixed(2)} °C ${p.rank ? `(#${p.rank})` : ''}</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-sub" id="an-stat-ocean-sub">HadISST DMI ${p.dmi >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${p.dmi.toFixed(2)} °C &bull; ${p.distStr ? `D=${p.distStr}` : ''}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="profile-stat-box">
            <div class="profile-stat-label">Observed ${p.year} Rainfall (OND)</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-val" id="an-stat-rain" style="color: ${rainColor};">${rainText}</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-sub" id="an-stat-rain-sub">${rainSub}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="profile-stat-box">
            <div class="profile-stat-label">Observed ${p.year} Pasture (NDVI)</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-val" id="an-stat-pasture" style="color: ${pastureColor};">${pastureText}</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-sub" id="an-stat-pasture-sub">${pastureSub}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="profile-stat-box">
            <div class="profile-stat-label">Observed ${p.year} Terms of Trade (ToT)</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-val" id="an-stat-tot">${totText}</div>
            <div class="profile-stat-sub" id="an-stat-tot-sub">${totSub}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="two-season-synthesis-box">
          <h4 style="font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;" id="an-syn-title">
            ${p.synTitle}
          </h4>
          <p id="an-syn-desc" style="font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
            ${p.synDesc}
          </p>
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #64748b; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 0.45rem;" id="an-syn-takeaway">
            <strong>Planning Precedent (${p.year}):</strong> ${p.synPrecedent}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // VIEW 2: OCEAN-STATE CURVE (CURRENT VS ANALOGUE TRAJECTORY)
  if (fig22View === "Ocean-state curve (Current vs Analogue)") {
    const monthNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
    
    // Historical analogue monthly trajectory
    const anRows = drivers.filter((d) => d.year === p.year).sort((a, b) => a.month - b.month);
    const curveAnalogue = anRows.map((d) => ({
      month: d.month,
      monthName: monthNames[d.month - 1],
      roni: d.roni,
      series: `Analogue ${p.year} (#${p.rank})`
    }));

    // Current-year trajectory: observed RONI (3-month seasons centred on each month) for the latest
    // year in the driver parquets, then the IRI multi-model plume median for the remaining months of
    // that year. The plume is a Niño 3.4 anomaly, not RONI (D17.2) — labelled as such, never typed.
    const curYear = d3.max(drivers.filter((d) => d.roni != null), (d) => d.year);
    const curObs = drivers.filter((d) => d.year === curYear && d.roni != null).sort((a, b) => a.month - b.month);
    const curveCurrent = [];
    curObs.forEach((d) => {
      curveCurrent.push({
        month: d.month,
        monthName: monthNames[d.month - 1],
        roni: d.roni,
        series: `Current ${curYear} (Observed RONI)`
      });
    });
    const lastObsMonth = curObs.length ? curObs[curObs.length - 1].month : 0;
    const seasonCentre = { DJF: 1, JFM: 2, FMA: 3, MAM: 4, AMJ: 5, MJJ: 6, JJA: 7, JAS: 8, ASO: 9, SON: 10, OND: 11, NDJ: 12 };
    const plumeSeasons = iriPlumeBundle?.current?.seasons || [];
    const plumeYears = iriPlumeBundle?.current?.seasonYears || [];
    const plumeLabel = `IRI plume median, issued ${iriPlumeBundle?.metadata?.issueLabel || 'n/a'} (Niño 3.4, not RONI)`;
    plumeSeasons.forEach((sea, idx) => {
      const m = seasonCentre[sea];
      if (plumeYears[idx] !== curYear || m == null || m <= lastObsMonth) return;
      const vals = (iriPlumeBundle.current.models || []).map((mm) => mm.data[idx]).filter((v) => v != null).sort((x, y) => x - y);
      if (!vals.length) return;
      curveCurrent.push({ month: m, monthName: monthNames[m - 1], roni: d3.median(vals), series: plumeLabel });
    });

    const trajectoryPlot = Plot.plot({
      width: 680,
      height: 310,
      marginTop: 25,
      marginRight: 40,
      marginBottom: 35,
      marginLeft: 45,
      y: {
        domain: [Math.min(-1.5, (d3.min(curveCurrent, (d) => d.roni) ?? 0) - 0.3), Math.max(2.5, (d3.max(curveCurrent, (d) => d.roni) ?? 0) + 0.4)],
        label: "SST Anomaly (°C) — RONI observed, Niño 3.4 plume",
        grid: true
      },
      x: {
        domain: d3.range(1, 13),
        tickFormat: (m) => monthNames[m - 1],
        label: "Month of Year (1–12)"
      },
      marks: [
        // Pre-season predictor window JAS (Months 7-9)
        Plot.rectX([{x1: 6.5, x2: 9.5}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#f1f5f9", fillOpacity: 0.6}),
        Plot.text([{x: 8, y: 2.3}], {x: "x", y: "y", text: () => "JAS Predictor Window", fontSize: 8.5, fill: "#475569", fontWeight: 600}),

        // Target season OND (Months 10-12)
        Plot.rectX([{x1: 9.5, x2: 12.5}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#fde68a", fillOpacity: 0.35}),
        Plot.text([{x: 11, y: 2.3}], {x: "x", y: "y", text: () => "OND Target Season", fontSize: 8.5, fill: "#92400e", fontWeight: 700}),

        // Zero and threshold rules
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.ruleY([0.5], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1}),
        Plot.ruleY([-0.5], {stroke: "#0284c7", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1}),

        // Analogue Year Curve (Blue Solid)
        Plot.line(curveAnalogue, {x: "month", y: "roni", stroke: "#0284c7", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
        Plot.dot(curveAnalogue, {
          x: "month", y: "roni", fill: "#0284c7", r: 4,
          title: (d) => `${d.monthName} ${p.year}: ${d.roni.toFixed(2)} °C RONI`
        }),

        // Current Year Curve (Red/Orange Dashed)
        Plot.line(curveCurrent.filter((d) => d.series.includes("Observed")), {x: "month", y: "roni", stroke: "#dc2626", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
        Plot.line(curveCurrent.filter((d) => d.series.includes("plume") || d.month === lastObsMonth), {x: "month", y: "roni", stroke: "#ea580c", strokeWidth: 2.2, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
        Plot.dot(curveCurrent, {
          x: "month", y: "roni", fill: (d) => d.series.includes("Observed") ? "#dc2626" : "#ea580c", r: 4,
          title: (d) => `${d.monthName} ${curYear} (${d.series}): ${d.roni.toFixed(2)} °C`
        })
      ]
    });

    return html`
      <div style="padding: 0.5rem 0;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
            Ocean-State Curve Comparison: Current (2026) vs Historical Analogue (${p.year})
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.74rem;">
            <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
              <span style="width: 14px; height: 3px; background: #0284c7; display: inline-block;"></span> Analogue ${p.year} (Rank #${p.rank})
            </span>
            <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
              <span style="width: 14px; height: 3px; background: #dc2626; display: inline-block;"></span> 2026 Observed
            </span>
            <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
              <span style="width: 14px; height: 3px; background: #ea580c; border-top: 1px dashed #ea580c; display: inline-block;"></span> 2026 Projected
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center;">
          ${trajectoryPlot}
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.4rem; text-align: center; line-height: 1.45;">
          Comparing continuous month-by-month trajectory reveals onset rate, peak timing, and post-peak decay. Standardized distance D = ${p.distStr} evaluated in joint pre-season predictor space (JAS).
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // VIEW 3: COUNTY SPATIAL CONTEXT & EVIDENCE LINK
  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 1.5rem; text-align: center; margin: 0.5rem 0;">
      <div style="display: inline-block; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0369a1; background: #e0f2fe; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
        Spatial Evidence Link &bull; Rule D1
      </div>
      <h4 style="font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;">
        5km High-Resolution Gridded Satellite Evidence for ${county} (${p.year})
      </h4>
      <p style="font-size: 0.86rem; color: #475569; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem auto; line-height: 1.55;">
        In ${p.year}, ${county} experienced a seasonal rainfall anomaly of <strong>${p.ondAnom >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${p.ondAnom}%</strong> (${p.ondVal} mm total). To prevent map duplication across the notebook, inspect the continuous 5km CHIRPS precipitation anomaly, WRSI crop/pasture satisfaction, and MODIS vegetation condition grids directly in Section 3:
      </p>
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="btn-dataset-jump"
          onclick="switchTab('tab-graphs')"
          style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #0284c7; color: #ffffff; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.86rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.2);"
        >
          <span>Open Section 3 Historical Climate Evidence &rarr;</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// Watcher: Mount Figure 2.2 Dynamic Content
{
  [county, sec4Profile, fig22View, sec4Figure22View];
  const host = document.getElementById("fig22ContentHost");
  if (host && sec4Figure22View) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec4Figure22View);
  }

  // Mount Figure 2.2 plotFooter
  const fHost = document.getElementById("fig22FooterHost");
  if (fHost && sec4Profile) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Historical analogue scenario multi-hazard profile for ${county} in ${sec4Profile.year} (MAM + OND compound cycle).`,
      fHost,
      {
        fig: "2.2",
        filename: `${county}_analogue_scenario_${sec4Profile.year}`,
        data: [sec4Profile],
        about: `Multi-hazard empirical diagnostic reconciling Pacific RONI and Indian Ocean DMI sea surface temperature anomalies with CHIRPS v3 rainfall, MODIS dekadal NDVI pasture dynamics, and pastoral Terms of Trade purchasing power. Synthesizes two-season compound hazard propagation for county climate risk contingency planning.`,
        meta: { County: county, AnalogueYear: sec4Profile.year, Rank: sec4Profile.rank, Distance: sec4Profile.distStr, RONI: sec4Profile.roni, DMI: sec4Profile.dmi }
      }
    );
    fHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}
